AuditResults.CheckTitle: Ensure Root Account Has MFA Enabled
AuditResults.FindingDescription: The root user account does not have a hardware or virtual MFA device configured.
AuditResults.RiskDescription: Compromise of root credentials grants full administrative control without secondary authentication factor.

AuditResults.CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets Block Public Access
AuditResults.FindingDescription: S3 Public Access Block is disabled on bucket containing sensitive customer KYC documents.
AuditResults.RiskDescription: Risk of unauthenticated data exfiltration resulting in regulatory fines and brand damage.

AuditResults.CheckTitle: Ensure MFA is Enabled for All IAM Users with Console Access
AuditResults.FindingDescription: IAM user dev-deployer-prod has active console login password without MFA device bound.
AuditResults.RiskDescription: Credential stuffing or phishing could yield interactive access to deployment environments.

AuditResults.CheckTitle: Ensure Security Groups Do Not Allow Ingress From 0.0.0.0/0 to Port 22 (SSH)
AuditResults.FindingDescription: Security group attached to DB subnet allows unrestricted inbound SSH (Port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0.
AuditResults.RiskDescription: Direct exposure of backend infrastructure to internet-wide brute-force and exploit attempts.

AuditResults.CheckTitle: Ensure CloudTrail is Enabled Across All Regions
AuditResults.FindingDescription: CloudTrail is only enabled in us-east-1; non-default regions have unmonitored API activity.
AuditResults.RiskDescription: Attacker operating in secondary regions (e.g., eu-west-1) can spin up unauthorized resources undetected.

AuditResults.CheckTitle: Ensure Automatic Key Rotation is Enabled for AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys
AuditResults.FindingDescription: KMS Key protecting transaction logs does not have annual automatic key rotation turned on.
AuditResults.RiskDescription: Long-term cryptographic key reuse increases blast radius if key material is ever compromised.
